evidence_items.explanation: The surveys document AI-related job concerns and associations between consultation and workplace outcomes. They cover finance and manufacturing in 2022 and do not establish that lacking union protections caused tech workers' generative-AI anxiety in early 2023.

This union announcement establishes representation for ZeniMax quality-assurance workers, qualifying a literal reading that tech had no unions. It establishes neither specific generative-AI layoff protections nor their effect on anxiety.

unresolved_gaps: No located study isolates the effect of union protections on tech workers' generative-AI layoff anxiety during the target period.
The located evidence does not establish the prevalence or strength of relevant layoff protections across tech workplaces.
General evidence about consultation or AI-related anxiety cannot establish the asserted causal direction.
